function relocate_exclusion_blocked_goals!(env;)
    before = zone_blockage(env)
    if before.project_blocked === true || before.n_completion_blocked > 0
        moved = translate_whole_build!(env)
        if !(moved.status in (:translated, :already_clear))
            error("Unable to relocate exclusion-blocked goals: $(moved.status)")
        end
    end

    validate_schedule_transform_tree(env.sched) ||
        error("Relocation violated schedule/scene-tree transform consistency")

    after = zone_blockage(env)
    if after.project_blocked === true ||
       after.n_completion_blocked > 0 ||
       after.n_nav_blocked > 0
        error("Relocation left required navigation goals blocked")
    end

    return (; status = :success)
end
